paragraphs: My journey began as a curious CS student at **Vedas College**, where I discovered the immense power of code to bring abstract ideas to life. This academic foundation paved the way for my role as a Junior Frontend Developer at **Anand Marketing Tech**.
I found my niche in the intersection of aesthetics and logic. My true passion lies in ==bridging the gap== between intricate Figma designs and high-performance, production-ready React applications.
